Librarian Eternal Debtor is an Eternal Debtor bound in servitude to  Raphael.
“
I will make them perfect! Pages crisp with lines and letters. I will make them beautiful for him, I promise. I promise.
„
— Librarian Eternal Debtor

Involvement

Act Three

Four Librarian Eternal Debtors are within the Archive of the House of Hope. They are busy with various routine tasks.
